$comment: Written by agentic-cms schema from the collection's zod schema; do not edit by hand.

path.description: The route: / for the home page, else /lowercase-words; indexed once published, never changed without a redirect

title.description: The exact <title> and og:title: the topic first, the brand last, 60 characters or fewer, unique across pages

description.description: The meta description: the page's promise in one sentence, 70–160 characters

ogImage.description: The social image, a 1200×630 JPEG under public/images/, e.g. /images/home-og.jpg

updated.description:
The date the content last changed, YYYY-MM-DD (quote it); the sitemap's lastmod — bump it with the copy, not on refactors
A date, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted in YAML.

breadcrumb.description: The page's name in the breadcrumb trail and its structured data

seo.description: The SEO block: the <title>, meta description, canonical, Open Graph image, sitemap entry and breadcrumb name

application.description: The SoftwareApplication the page is about; left out, the page describes no software (a notice, a policy, a page of plain text)

name.description: The SoftwareApplication's name as it should read in structured data

description.description: One sentence on what the application is

featureList.description: The featureList, one short line each

signIn.description: true adds the sign-in URL and the social profiles to the application

anyOf.description: The SoftwareApplication the page is about

itemList.description: An ItemList of the page's use-case cards (needs a use-case-cards section)

organization.description: How the organisation is attached to the application: as its provider (with its URL) or its publisher; only with an application

oneOf.description: A WebPage: about the software when it carries an application, otherwise a page of its own (a notice, a policy)

foundingDate.description:
The founding date, YYYY-MM-DD
A date, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted in YAML.

knowsAbout.description: The topics the organisation knows about

organization.description: The organisation the page is about; name, logo, e-mail and profiles come from site.ts

oneOf.description: An AboutPage about the organisation, with the page's FAQ as its FAQPage (needs a faq section)

email.description: The e-mail address; left out, the contact point carries the page's URL instead (an address kept out of the HTML)

oneOf.description: A ContactPage with the organisation's address and contact points, and the page's FAQ as its FAQPage (needs a faq section)
A Blog listing every published post (nothing to declare)

jsonld.description: The page's structured data: the copy of its JSON-LD block by page type

sections.description: The sections in order, each a `type` and its copy

description: content/pages: A page: content/pages/<slug>.yaml — its SEO block, its structured data, and its sections in order (seo.path is the route; the file name is only the key) (one file per entry, the file name is the slug).
